description: Return all compliance nodes that apply in a specific jurisdiction (EU, US, UK, Australia, Singapore, India, Canada, China, South Africa, Japan, Brazil and others). Use when an agent enters a new market and needs the full regulatory surface for that geography.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code or name: eu, us, uk, au, sg, india, canada, china, south-africa, japan, brazil.

limit.description: Max nodes to return. Default 25. Max 100.

name: get_jurisdiction_bundle
